description: Defines the IgnitableComponent class, which manages fire-related behavior such as ignition, extinguishing, damage, and spreading within the game. Contains static constants for damage and burn times, and methods for handling fire logic.

classes.name: IgnitableComponent
classes.description: A component class that handles fire ignition, extinguishing, damage, and spread logic for game entities.

methods.name: IgnitableComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IgnitableComponent with entity, fire state, and dependencies.

methods.name: HandlePrepareNetCode
methods.description: Handles network preparation for the component.

methods.name: HandleIgnite
methods.description: Handles ignition event, starting fire on the entity.

methods.name: HandleExtinguish
methods.description: Handles extinguishing the fire on the entity.

methods.name: DamageSelf
methods.description: Applies damage to the entity itself over time.

methods.name: DamageArea
methods.description: Applies area damage around the entity.

methods.name: ConsiderStop
methods.description: Determines if the fire should stop burning.

methods.name: ConsiderSpread
methods.description: Evaluates whether the fire should spread to nearby entities.
